headline: Pakistan Government Lowers Petrol Price by Re 1, Keeps Diesel Unchanged
summary: Pakistan's government decreased the price of petrol by Re 1 to Rs 312 per litre while keeping diesel rates unchanged at Rs 346 per litre, effective Saturday.
why: Retail fuel prices in Pakistan are regulated by the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority and directly influence domestic transport and consumer inflation.

impacts.name: Petrol
impacts.why: The government reduced petrol prices to Rs312 per litre.
